title: eludite.workspace.open_project input
description: File > Open Project/Solution... (brief 0072): open a .NET solution (.sln, .slnx), solution filter (.slnf) or project file (.csproj, .vbproj, .fsproj) as the workspace of its folder, with that file as the folder's .NET part (eludite.workspace.open_folder with the file). From the UI without `path` it shows a file dialog first. Opening replaces the workspace.

path.description: Absolute path of the .sln, .slnx, .slnf, .csproj, .vbproj or .fsproj file.
